_readme: 中文美术字 → 英文译名表，两族共用一份。
artfont 族：key 是 ArtFont_zh/OperatingPanelAtlas 下的文件名（*_bg_zh.png），title = 小标题、lines = 下方大标题按数组逐行排（最多 4 行）。
atlas 族：key 是 Atlas/<面板>/ 下的文件名（没有 _zh 后缀，如 cn2-X1_kuafu_rukou.png），图上本来就只有一块大标语 ⇒ 只写 lines，不写 title。
atlas 族没有「扫全目录」的余地（图集里绝大多数图没有中文），所以本表就是白名单：有 lines 的才做。
glyph 族（2026-10-22）：ArtFont_zh 下「小型 + 单色」的美术字块（页签/竖排标题），也只支持白名单。
额外字段：zh_text = 图上那句中文原文（提示词里要写给它看）；gpt_layout = 版面怎么摆（人话描述，只对 glyph 生效）。
整幅族（artfont / atlas，2026-10-22 起）：gpt_layout 同样生效 —— 英文比中文长 3~4 倍时显式给宽度上限（像素坐标 + 「超了压字距降字高，绝不拉宽底板」），否则模型会把字铺到实心区外、被 alpha lock 直接啃掉。
poster 族（2026-10-22）：ArtFont_zh/DynamicActivityPanelAtlas/banner 下的 884x856 全幅海报（插画+彩带+两行美术字）。
同样只走白名单；字段与 glyph 一致（zh_text / lines / gpt_layout），但 lines 按「第 1 行大、其后依次」排。
已上线英文图（pata_bg_en / shenyuan_bg_en）的用词与之不完全一致时，以已上线图为准，别自己另造。
第三行「累计返利 __ 倍」在 pata_bg_en / shenyuan_bg_en 里都是被删掉的（留给 UI 动态数字），这里同样不排。

cn2-X1_jingyinghuodong_banner_12_zh.png.note: 精英活动横幅「终身限购礼包」/ 小字「珍稀道具，永久限购！」（ArtFont_zh/ExpertPanelAtlas/banner，884x336 全幅不透明：几何底 + 黑色斜切彩带 + 两行美术字）。🔴 尺寸落在 artfont 带里，但本图是彩带满幅、不是 884x544 三段版面 ⇒ local 的锚点用不上，实际跑 --family poster（整幅重绘 + 四边背景闸门）+ --provider chatgpt_web。译名口径：礼包→PACK（同 banner_10 'CP Boosted Pack'）；永久限购→Permanent Purchase Limit（Language.lua 里有这条英文）。译名待产品确认

cn2-X1_zhongshenhuiyuan_peitu_zh.png.zh_text: 一次激活 终生有效 / 终身（下方已印 PRIVILEGE）/ 激活后每日可领取一张 会员招募卡 / （激活时可获得全部已累计的奖励）
cn2-X1_zhongshenhuiyuan_peitu_zh.png.gpt_layout: GLOBAL FIT RULE (applies to every line below): each English line must occupy at most the same horizontal span as the Chinese line it replaces, measured from its first to its last glyph, and must stay completely inside the plate that carries it — same left margin, same right margin, no letter touching or crossing a ribbon edge, no letter sitting on the background or on the purple card behind. When the English would be wider than the Chinese, CONDENSE the letters horizontally or reduce their height until it fits. Never widen, thicken or extend a ribbon, plate or card. (1) Top yellow slanted ribbon, one line: 'ACTIVATE ONCE, VALID FOREVER' — two phrases on the same baseline with a small gap, bold dark-brown letters with a thin light rim, starting where the Chinese started and ending well before the ribbon's right tip (the Chinese ended ~80px before it). (2) The huge hand-lettered headline on the tilted golden card: replace the two Chinese characters with the single word 'LIFETIME', same white-to-yellow inner gradient, same thick orange outline and hard drop shadow, same slight clockwise tilt. It must be narrower than a naive stretch: at least 30px of plain gold card must stay visible to the right of the last letter, exactly like the Chinese character had. The word 'PRIVILEGE' printed in brown directly under it is already English: keep it exactly where it is, unchanged. (3) The wide golden ribbon across the middle, ONE line only: 'GET 1 MEMBER SUMMON CARD DAILY'. Keep the same split in styling as the Chinese: 'MEMBER SUMMON CARD' in the big arched silver-white letters with a dark outline (where the Chinese item name was), 'GET 1' before it and 'DAILY' after it in the smaller dark-brown bold letters. It starts just right of the two orange chevron arrows at the left tip and ends at least 20px before the ribbon's right tip. (4) The small parenthetical line under the ribbon, centred: '(ALL ACCUMULATED REWARDS GRANTED ON ACTIVATION)', dark brown, same small height and the same centred span as the Chinese line, condensed to fit. Keep every crystal, the VIP card and the purple panel exactly as they are.
cn2-X1_zhongshenhuiyuan_peitu_zh.png.note: 终身会员特权卡配图（ArtFont_zh/OperatingPanelAtlas，884x1480 竖版异形卡：顶部黄色斜切彩带 + 金色斜卡上的巨型「终身」美术字 + 中段金色横彩带 + 底部小字；四边 79%~92% 是 alpha=0，透明区占 17.4%）。译名口径：终身→LIFETIME（压在已印好的 PRIVILEGE 上，合起来是 LIFETIME PRIVILEGE）；会员招募卡→Member Summon Card（Language.lua 道具表原译）；激活后领取与累计奖励沿用 Language.lua「After activation, you can receive … per day」「(All accumulated rewards can be obtained when activated)」的意思，按美术字可用宽度收短（英文比中文长 3~4 倍，超宽必然压不住版面）。🔴 图上 PRIVILEGE 与 VIP 本来就是英文，提示词里已显式交代不许动。译名待产品确认

cn2-x1_texie_aijiyanhou_01_zh.png.gpt_layout: TARGET TEXT IS FIXED — copy it verbatim, do NOT translate anything yourself. The only words allowed on this artwork are 'BREATH OF' on the first row and 'TEMPTATION' on the second row. Do NOT substitute a different skill name, a synonym or a shortened form; the Chinese 诱惑之息 is NOT to be translated by you — its English wording has already been decided and is exactly the two rows above. LAYOUT (this overrides the 'same line count' rule above — the Chinese is ONE row of four characters, the English MUST be TWO rows, because twenty letters cannot fit on one row of this banner): safe text box, measured on the 512x256 canvas, x≈100..406 y≈100..163. The Chinese gold strokes span x≈95..413 / y≈101..162, and the black stroke silhouette that carries them ends at x≈415 — beyond x≈408 there is only the tapered brush tail and sparse halftone dots, and anything drawn there is cut off by the artwork's own silhouette / alpha lock. Row 1 'BREATH OF' (9 characters) at cap height ≈28px sitting y≈101..129; row 2 'TEMPTATION' (10 characters) at the same ≈28px cap height sitting y≈134..162; both rows left-aligned at x≈100, tight letter-spacing, bold condensed latin capitals, the same flat gold (#FFD738) fill with the same thick near-black outline as the Chinese strokes they replace. Leave ≥10px clearance before x≈406 so a slightly wider rendering still stays inside. Do NOT raise the glyph height above ~30px and do NOT stretch either row past x≈406 — an oversized single row is exactly what got the first and last letters clipped in earlier attempts. Keep the small 'HERO-SKILL' label at the top-left exactly where it is — it is already English and must stay unchanged. Never widen, extend or re-shape the banner; never drop or truncate any letter, in particular the final 'F' of BREATH OF and the final 'N' of TEMPTATION.
cn2-x1_texie_aijiyanhou_01_zh.png.note: 爱姬艳后英雄特写技能横幅「HERO-SKILL 诱惑之息」（ArtFont_zh/font，512x256 RGBA 透明底：黑色笔刷横幅底板 + 金黄渐变大字，左上小字 HERO-SKILL 本来就是英文不许动）。译名取语言表 38010002「Breath of Temptation」（jp テンプテーションブレス / kr 유혹의 숨결 同源）。同系列口径同 cn2-x1_texie_baiqi_01：尺寸落在 artfont 带但不是 884x544 三段版面、也不是单色 glyph ⇒ local 锚点与 600x400 闸门都不适用，必须 chatgpt_web；family=auto 判成 artfont 即走「整幅重绘 + alpha lock + 可见区改动 2%~75%」口径

cn2-x1_texie_baiqi_01_zh.png.note: 白起英雄特写技能横幅「HERO·SKILL 血之回响」（ArtFont_zh/font，512x256 RGBA 透明底：黑色笔刷横幅底板 + 粉色大字，左上小字 HERO·SKILL 本来就是英文不许动）。译名取语言表 38010134「Echoes of Blood」（jp 血の反響 / kr 피의 울림 同源）。尺寸落在 artfont 带但不是 884x544 三段版面、也不是单色 glyph（4 种主色）⇒ local 锚点与 600x400 闸门都不适用，必须 chatgpt_web；family=auto 判成 artfont 即走「整幅重绘 + alpha lock + 可见区改动 2%~75%」口径

cn2-x1_texie_hasang_01_zh.png.gpt_layout: TARGET TEXT IS FIXED — copy it verbatim, do NOT translate anything yourself. The only words allowed on this artwork are 'DARK SACRIFICE'. Do NOT substitute another skill name, a synonym or a shortened form; the Chinese 恶魔献祭 is NOT yours to translate — its English wording has already been decided and is exactly those two words. ERASE-FIRST (critical): completely remove all four Chinese characters 恶魔献祭 BEFORE drawing anything, leaving a clean black brush plate where they were — no residual Chinese strokes, no ghosting or double-exposure behind the English. The final artwork must contain ZERO Chinese characters. LAYOUT, measured on the 512x256 canvas: the four Chinese characters span x≈69..418 (350px wide) and y≈99..166; the solid black brush plate ends at x≈437, and everything left of x≈64 / right of x≈437 is the tapered ARROW TIP and is NOT writable area — letters placed there get cut off by the artwork's own silhouette / alpha lock. So 'DARK SACRIFICE' must be ONE row, left-aligned at x≈74 and ending NO FURTHER than x≈414 (about 340px of writable width), vertically centred on y≈132, cap height ≈42..48px. The English has 13 letters against four Chinese characters, so it must be SHORTER than the Chinese (68px tall) and must not get wider than it: condense the letters, keep tight letter-spacing, and keep at least 10px of black plate visible at both ends. If it does not fit, first tighten the letter-spacing, then lower the cap height toward 36px — never widen or re-shape the plate, and never let a letter touch the arrow tips. FINAL FALLBACK if it still does not fit: TWO left-aligned rows, 'DARK' above 'SACRIFICE', each ≈26px cap height, upper row y≈102..128 and lower row y≈136..162, both starting at x≈78 and ending by x≈405, with a clear gap between the rows. STYLE LOCK: fill every letter with the SAME flat hot pink (#FF79AB) as the Chinese strokes it replaces, with the same thin lighter-pink outer edge, the same soft dark drop shadow and the same bold, slightly italic brush letterforms — solid letterforms only, no gradient, no white streaks or torn-paper patches inside the letters. Do not leave or invent a space inside a word. IDENTITY LOCK: the background must stay the SAME black brush-stroke banner with the same sparse dark halftone dot pattern and the same two arrow tips pointing left and right; the white 'HERO-SKILL' label at the top-left must stay untouched (it is already English). Do NOT add any character, person, face, animal, scenery, illustration or new decoration — a redrawn background is a hard failure. Output a wide 2:1 banner with the same composition and framing as the reference.
cn2-x1_texie_hasang_01_zh.png.note: 哈桑英雄特写技能横幅「HERO-SKILL 恶魔献祭」（ArtFont_zh/font，512x256 RGBA 透明底：黑色笔刷横幅底板 + 网点 + 双箭头 + 粉色大字，左上小字 HERO-SKILL 本来就是英文不许动）。译名取语言表 38010150「Dark Sacrifice」（jp サクリファイス / kr 악마의 제사 同源）。同系列口径同 cn2-x1_texie_baiqi_01：512x256 落在 artfont 带但不是 884x544 三段版面、也不是单色 glyph（粉色 + 抗锯齿边，远多于 8 色）⇒ local 锚点与 600x400 闸门都不适用，必须 chatgpt_web；family=auto 判成 artfont 即走「整幅重绘 + alpha lock + 可见区改动 2%~75%」口径。实测几何：中文 x69..418 / y99..166，实心板右界 x≈437，箭头尖在 x<64 与 x>437；单行 13 字母按 zhende「DIVINE JUDGMENT」/ baiqi「Echoes of Blood」实测（339~349px 宽、42~46px 高）放得进同一带，故默认单行 + 两行兜底，不强制两行

cn2-x1_texie_mozhate_01_zh.png.gpt_layout: TARGET TEXT IS FIXED — copy it verbatim, do NOT translate anything yourself. The only words allowed on this artwork are 'AVE VERUM' on the first row and 'CORPUS' on the second row. Do NOT substitute a different skill name or a synonym; an earlier attempt ignored this and wrongly wrote 'DIVINE JUDGMENT', which was rejected. The Chinese 圣体颂 is NOT to be translated by you — its English wording has already been decided. LAYOUT (this overrides the 'same line count' rule above — the Chinese is one line of three characters, the English MUST be TWO rows, because sixteen letters cannot fit on one row of this ribbon). Measured on the 512x256 canvas, the solid brush plate spans x≈93..388 between y≈96..168; at y≈170 and below it breaks up into a tapered tail, and beyond x≈388 there are only sparse halftone dots — anything drawn outside that box is cut off by the artwork's own silhouette / alpha lock. Previous attempt ended row 1 at x≈393 and lost the right edge of the final 'M'. So: Row 1 'AVE VERUM' — cap height ≈28px, occupies y≈98..126, left edge x≈100, right edge NO FURTHER than x≈365. Row 2 'CORPUS' — cap height ≈28px, occupies y≈140..168, same left edge x≈100, right edge NO FURTHER than x≈365. Keep a clear ≈14px gap between the two rows — do NOT let the rows touch or overlap (the previous attempt stacked them 4px apart and they collide). LETTER STYLE, this is where the previous attempt failed: fill every letter with the SAME flat blue vertical gradient as the Chinese strokes it replaces (light blue at the top → deeper blue at the bottom) plus the same thin dark outline. Do NOT put white or near-white blocks, streaks, inner highlights or torn-paper patches inside the letters — the previous attempt left white debris inside the E and R. Solid letterforms only. Keep the small 'HERO-SKILL' label at the top-left exactly where it is — it is already English and must stay unchanged. Never widen, extend or re-shape the ribbon.
cn2-x1_texie_mozhate_01_zh.png.note: 莫扎特英雄特写技能横幅「HERO·SKILL 圣体颂」（ArtFont_zh/font，512x256 RGBA 透明底：黑色笔刷横幅底板 + 网点 + 蓝色渐变大字，左上小字 HERO·SKILL 本来就是英文不许动）。译名取语言表 38010065「Ave Verum Corpus」（jp 聖体賛美歌 同源；xlsx 与 Language.lua 技能名表逐位对齐双源核实：砍伐/Cut Down、圣体颂/Ave Verum Corpus、安魂曲/Requiem 相邻全对上）。同系列口径同 cn2-x1_texie_baiqi_01：512x256 落在 artfont 带但不是 884x544 三段版面、也不是单色 glyph（1000+ 种颜色）⇒ local 锚点与 600x400 闸门都不适用，必须 chatgpt_web；family=auto 判成 artfont 即走「整幅重绘 + alpha lock + 可见区改动 2%~75%」口径。🔴 首跑（#14）英文铺太宽，末字母 S 越过实心区掉进网点稀疏带被 alpha lock 啃掉半边 ⇒ gpt_layout 补显式宽度上限（整幅族 2026-10-22 新增逐条目 gpt_layout 钩子）

cn2-x1_texie_shiba_01_zh.png.note: 英雄特写技能横幅「HERO-SKILL 魔神的睿智」（ArtFont_zh/font，512x256 RGBA 透明底：白色 HERO-SKILL 小标 + 紫色大标题 + 锯齿星爆 + 双黑箭头 + 网点；左上 HERO-SKILL 本来就是英文不许动）。译名取自 Language.lua 技能名表逐位对齐（毒针/三道谜语/魔神的睿智/猎杀时刻 ↔ Poison Needle/Three Riddles/Devilish Wisdom/The Hunt）。🔴 512x256 落在 artfont 带但不是 884x544 三段版面、也不是单色 glyph（1000+ 种颜色）⇒ local 锚点与 600x400 闸门都不适用，必须 chatgpt_web；family=auto 判成 artfont 即走「整幅重绘 + alpha lock + 可见区改动 2%~75%」口径

cn2-x1_texie_zhende_01_zh.png.gpt_layout: WIDTH LIMIT (hard, measured on the 512x256 canvas): the black brush plate's SOLID body spans x≈85..421 only in the text row; everything left of x≈85 and right of x≈421 is the narrowing pointed ARROW TIP and is NOT writable area — letters placed there get cut off. So the whole English line must sit inside x≈95..410 (about 315px wide), vertically centred on y≈132, cap height at most ~55px. Do NOT let the first or last letter reach the plate edges: keep at least 10px of black plate visible at both ends. If 'DIVINE JUDGMENT' at cap height 55 still does not fit that span, first tighten letter-spacing, then lower the cap height toward 45px — never widen the plate and never let a letter touch the tips. FINAL FALLBACK if it still does not fit: break it into TWO left-aligned lines, 'DIVINE' above 'JUDGMENT', each ~28px cap height, upper row centred on y≈118 and lower row on y≈147, both starting at x≈105 and ending by x≈400 — the two rows must stay fully inside the black plate. IDENTITY LOCK: this is a logo/title plate, not a scene — the background must stay the SAME plain black brush-stroke banner with the same dark dot pattern and arrow tips, and the white 'HERO-SKILL' label at the top-left must stay untouched. Do NOT add any character, person, face, animal, scenery, illustration or new decoration; a redrawn background is a hard failure. Output a wide 2:1 banner with the same composition and framing as the reference.
cn2-x1_texie_zhende_01_zh.png.note: 真田英雄特写技能横幅「HERO-SKILL 神圣审判」（ArtFont_zh/font，512x256 RGBA 透明底：黑色笔刷横幅底板 + 橙金渐变大字，左上小字 HERO-SKILL 本来就是英文不许动）。译名取 Language.lua 技能名表「Divine Judgment」（同系列 Sacred Judgment 相邻对齐双源核实）。🔴 512x256 落在 artfont 带但不是 884x544 三段版面、也不是单色 glyph（橙金渐变 1000+ 种颜色）⇒ local 锚点与 600x400 闸门都不适用，必须 chatgpt_web；family=auto 判成 artfont 即走「整幅重绘 + alpha lock + 可见区改动 2%~75%」口径。🔴 2026-10-22 首轮 #16 实测：模型无视「只换字」，整幅重画成白发角色插画（改动 96.5% 打红、cover 裁回 512x256 时左侧字母被切）⇒ 已加 gpt_layout 显式「IDENTITY LOCK 禁止新增人物/插画 + 宽度上限 x79..417」

cn2-x1_texie_suoluomen_01_zh.png.gpt_layout: WIDTH LIMIT (hard, measured on the 512x256 canvas): the Chinese 恶魔之影 occupies x≈59..428 (about 369px wide, 86px tall, y≈120..206). The single English line 'DEMONIC SHADOW' is far wider than four Chinese characters, so it MUST be condensed to fit inside that same span — start at the same left edge (x≈59) and end no later than x≈425, keeping clearance from the banner's right boundary (the solid brush plate ends around x≈433; beyond that is only a sparse dotted tail and then full transparency, and anything drawn there is cut off by the artwork's own silhouette / alpha lock).
